verses.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἦν ἑορτὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ ἀνέβη Ἰησοῦς εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα
verses.transliteration: Meta tauta ēn heortē tōn Ioudaiōn kai anebē Iēsous eis Hierosolyma
verses.literal: Some time later . . . there was a feast of the Jews and Jesus went up to Jerusalem

verses.original: Ἔστιν δὲ ἐν τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐπὶ τῇ προβατικῇ κολυμβήθρα ἡ ἐπιλεγομένη Ἑβραϊστὶ Βηθεσδά πέντε στοὰς ἔχουσα
verses.transliteration: Estin de en tois Hierosolymois epi tē probatikē kolymbēthra hē epilegomenē Hebraisti Bēthesda pente stoas echousa
verses.literal: Now there is in Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool with five covered colonnades which in Hebrew is called Bethesda

verses.original: ἐν ταύταις κατέκειτο πλῆθος τῶν ἀσθενούντων τυφλῶν χωλῶν ξηρῶν
verses.transliteration: en tautais katekeito plēthos tōn asthenountōn typhlōn chōlōn xērōn
verses.literal: On these walkways lay a great number of the sick the blind the lame and the paralyzed

verses.original: Ἦν δέ τις ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖ τριάκοντα καὶ ὀκτὼ ἔτη ἔχων ἐν τῇ ἀσθενείᾳ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ēn de tis anthrōpos ekei triakonta kai oktō etē echōn en tē astheneia autou
verses.literal: One man there had been - an invalid for thirty-eight . . . . . . years

verses.original: τοῦτον ἰδὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς κατακείμενον καὶ γνοὺς ὅτι πολὺν ἤδη χρόνον ἔχει λέγει αὐτῷ Θέλεις ὑγιὴς γενέσθαι
verses.transliteration: touton idōn ho Iēsous katakeimenon kai gnous hoti polyn ēdē chronon echei legei autō Theleis hygiēs genesthai
verses.literal: When Jesus saw him lying there and realized that he had spent a long time in this condition He asked him Do you want to get well

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ ὁ ἀσθενῶν Κύριε ἄνθρωπον οὐκ ἔχω ἵνα ὅταν ταραχθῇ τὸ ὕδωρ βάλῃ με εἰς τὴν κολυμβήθραν ἐν ᾧ δὲ ἔρχομαι ἐγὼ ἄλλος πρὸ ἐμοῦ καταβαίνει
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē autō ho asthenōn Kyrie anthrōpon ouk echō hina hotan tarachthē to hydōr balē me eis tēn kolymbēthran en hō de erchomai egō allos pro emou katabainei
verses.literal: Sir the invalid replied I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred While . . . I am on my way someone else goes in before me

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἔγειρε ἆρον τὸν κράβαττόν σου καὶ περιπάτει
verses.transliteration: Legei autō ho Iēsous Egeire aron ton krabatton sou kai peripatei
verses.literal: Then Jesus told him Get up pick up your mat and walk

verses.original: Καὶ εὐθέως ἐγένετο ὑγιὴς ὁ ἄνθρωπος καὶ ἦρεν τὸν κράβαττον αὐτοῦ καὶ περιεπάτει Ἦν δὲ σάββατον ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ
verses.transliteration: Kai eutheōs egeneto hygiēs ho anthrōpos kai ēren ton krabatton autou kai periepatei Ēn de sabbaton en ekeinē tē hēmera
verses.literal: Immediately the man was made well and he picked up his mat and began to walk Now this happened on the Sabbath day

verses.original: ἔλεγον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι τῷ τεθεραπευμένῳ Σάββατόν ἐστιν καὶ οὐκ ἔξεστίν σοι ἆραι τὸν κράβαττον σου
verses.transliteration: elegon oun hoi Ioudaioi tō tetherapeumenō Sabbaton estin kai ouk exestin soi arai ton krabatton sou
verses.literal: so the Jews said to the man who had been healed This is the Sabbath It is unlawful for you to carry your mat

verses.original: ὃς δὲ ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς Ὁ ποιήσας με ὑγιῆ ἐκεῖνός μοι εἶπεν Ἆρον τὸν κράβαττόν σου καὶ περιπάτει
verses.transliteration: hos de apekrithē autois Ho poiēsas me hygiē ekeinos moi eipen Aron ton krabatton sou kai peripatei
verses.literal: But he answered The man who made me well told me Pick up your mat and walk

verses.original: Ἠρώτησαν οὖν αὐτόν Τίς ἐστιν ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ εἰπών σοι Ἆρον καὶ περιπάτει
verses.transliteration: Ērōtēsan oun auton Tis estin ho anthrōpos ho eipōn soi Aron kai peripatei
verses.literal: Who is this man who told you to pick it up and walk they asked

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἰαθεὶς οὐκ ᾔδει τίς ἐστιν ὁ γὰρ Ἰησοῦς ἐξένευσεν ὄχλου ὄντος ἐν τῷ τόπῳ
verses.transliteration: Ho de iatheis ouk ēdei tis estin ho gar Iēsous exeneusen ochlou ontos en tō topō
verses.literal: But the man who was healed did not know who it was for Jesus had slipped away while the crowd was there

verses.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα εὑρίσκει αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἴδε ὑγιὴς γέγονας μηκέτι ἁμάρτανε ἵνα μὴ χεῖρόν σοί τι γένηται
verses.transliteration: Meta tauta heuriskei auton ho Iēsous en tō hierō kai eipen autō Ide hygiēs gegonas mēketi hamartane hina mē cheiron soi ti genētai
verses.literal: Afterward . . . Jesus found the man at the temple and said to him See you have been made well Stop sinning or . . . something worse may happen to you

verses.original: ἀπῆλθεν ὁ ἄνθρωπος καὶ ἀνήγγειλεν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ ποιήσας αὐτὸν ὑγιῆ
verses.transliteration: apēlthen ho anthrōpos kai anēngeilen tois Ioudaiois hoti Iēsous estin ho poiēsas auton hygiē
verses.literal: And the man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well

verses.original: Καὶ διὰ τοῦτο ἐδίωκον οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι τὸν Ἰησοῦν ὅτι ταῦτα ἐποίει ἐν σαββάτῳ
verses.transliteration: Kai dia touto ediōkon hoi Ioudaioi ton Iēsoun hoti tauta epoiei en sabbatō
verses.literal: Now because . . . Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath the Jews began to persecute Him

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἀπεκρίνατο αὐτοῖς Ὁ Πατήρ μου ἕως ἄρτι ἐργάζεται κἀγὼ ἐργάζομαι
verses.transliteration: ho de Iēsous apekrinato autois Ho Patēr mou heōs arti ergazetai kagō ergazomai
verses.literal: But Jesus answered them To this very day My Father is at His work and I too am working

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο οὖν μᾶλλον ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἀποκτεῖναι ὅτι οὐ μόνον ἔλυεν τὸ σάββατον ἀλλὰ καὶ Πατέρα ἴδιον ἔλεγεν τὸν Θεόν ἴσον ἑαυτὸν ποιῶν τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: Dia touto oun mallon ezētoun auton hoi Ioudaioi apokteinai hoti ou monon elyen to sabbaton alla kai Patera idion elegen ton Theon ison heauton poiōn tō Theō
verses.literal: Because of this the Jews tried all the harder to kill Him Not only was He breaking the Sabbath but He was even calling God His own Father making Himself equal with God

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίνατο οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν οὐ δύναται ὁ Υἱὸς ποιεῖν ἀφ’ ἑαυτοῦ οὐδὲν ἐὰν μή τι βλέπῃ τὸν Πατέρα ποιοῦντα ἃ γὰρ ἂν ἐκεῖνος ποιῇ ταῦτα καὶ ὁ Υἱὸς ὁμοίως ποιεῖ
verses.transliteration: Apekrinato oun ho Iēsous kai elegen autois Amēn amēn legō hymin ou dynatai ho Huios poiein aph’ heautou ouden ean mē ti blepē ton Patera poiounta ha gar an ekeinos poiē tauta kai ho Huios homoiōs poiei
verses.literal: So Jesus replied . . . . . . . . . Truly truly I tell you the Son can do nothing by Himself unless . . . He sees the Father doing it For whatever . . . the Father does the Son also does

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ Πατὴρ φιλεῖ τὸν Υἱὸν καὶ πάντα δείκνυσιν αὐτῷ ἃ αὐτὸς ποιεῖ καὶ μείζονα τούτων δείξει αὐτῷ ἔργα ἵνα ὑμεῖς θαυμάζητε
verses.transliteration: ho gar Patēr philei ton Huion kai panta deiknysin autō ha autos poiei kai meizona toutōn deixei autō erga hina hymeis thaumazēte
verses.literal: The Father loves the Son and shows Him all He does And to your amazement He will show Him even greater works than these

verses.original: Ὥσπερ γὰρ ὁ Πατὴρ ἐγείρει τοὺς νεκροὺς καὶ ζωοποιεῖ οὕτως καὶ ὁ Υἱὸς οὓς θέλει ζωοποιεῖ
verses.transliteration: Hōsper gar ho Patēr egeirei tous nekrous kai zōopoiei houtōs kai ho Huios hous thelei zōopoiei
verses.literal: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life so also the Son gives life to whom He wishes

verses.original: οὐδὲ γὰρ ὁ Πατὴρ κρίνει οὐδένα ἀλλὰ τὴν κρίσιν πᾶσαν δέδωκεν τῷ Υἱῷ
verses.transliteration: oude gar ho Patēr krinei oudena alla tēn krisin pasan dedōken tō Huiō
verses.literal: Furthermore the Father judges no one . . . but has assigned all judgment to the Son

verses.original: ἵνα πάντες τιμῶσι τὸν Υἱὸν καθὼς τιμῶσι τὸν Πατέρα ὁ μὴ τιμῶν τὸν Υἱὸν οὐ τιμᾷ τὸν Πατέρα τὸν πέμψαντα αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: hina pantes timōsi ton Huion kathōs timōsi ton Patera ho mē timōn ton Huion ou tima ton Patera ton pempsanta auton
verses.literal: so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him

verses.original: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὁ τὸν λόγον μου ἀκούων καὶ πιστεύων τῷ πέμψαντί με ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον καὶ εἰς κρίσιν οὐκ ἔρχεται ἀλλὰ μεταβέβηκεν ἐκ τοῦ θανάτου εἰς τὴν ζωήν
verses.transliteration: Amēn amēn legō hymin hoti ho ton logon mou akouōn kai pisteuōn tō pempsanti me echei zōēn aiōnion kai eis krisin ouk erchetai alla metabebēken ek tou thanatou eis tēn zōēn
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you whoever hears My word and believes Him who sent Me has eternal life and will not come under judgment Indeed he has crossed over from death to life

verses.original: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἔρχεται ὥρα καὶ νῦν ἐστιν ὅτε οἱ νεκροὶ ἀκούσουσιν τῆς φωνῆς τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀκούσαντες ζήσουσιν
verses.transliteration: Amēn amēn legō hymin hoti erchetai hōra kai nyn estin hote hoi nekroi akousousin tēs phōnēs tou Huiou tou Theou kai hoi akousantes zēsousin
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you the hour is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God and those who hear will live

verses.original: ὥσπερ γὰρ ὁ Πατὴρ ἔχει ζωὴν ἐν ἑαυτῷ οὕτως καὶ τῷ Υἱῷ ἔδωκεν ζωὴν ἔχειν ἐν ἑαυτῷ
verses.transliteration: hōsper gar ho Patēr echei zōēn en heautō houtōs kai tō Huiō edōken zōēn echein en heautō
verses.literal: For as the Father has life in Himself so also He has granted the Son to have life in Himself

verses.original: καὶ ἐξουσίαν ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ κρίσιν ποιεῖν ὅτι Υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου ἐστίν
verses.transliteration: kai exousian edōken autō krisin poiein hoti Huios anthrōpou estin
verses.literal: And He has given Him authority to execute judgment because He is the Son of Man

verses.original: μὴ θαυμάζετε τοῦτο ὅτι ἔρχεται ὥρα ἐν ᾗ πάντες οἱ ἐν τοῖς μνημείοις ἀκούσουσιν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: mē thaumazete touto hoti erchetai hōra en hē pantes hoi en tois mnēmeiois akousousin tēs phōnēs autou
verses.literal: Do not be amazed at this for the hour is coming when . . . all who are in their graves will hear His voice

verses.original: καὶ ἐκπορεύσονται οἱ τὰ ἀγαθὰ ποιήσαντες εἰς ἀνάστασιν ζωῆς οἱ δὲ τὰ φαῦλα πράξαντες εἰς ἀνάστασιν κρίσεως
verses.transliteration: kai ekporeusontai hoi ta agatha poiēsantes eis anastasin zōēs hoi de ta phaula praxantes eis anastasin kriseōs
verses.literal: and come out those who have done good to the resurrection of life and those who have done evil to the resurrection of judgment

verses.original: Οὐ δύναμαι ἐγὼ ποιεῖν ἀπ’ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐδέν καθὼς ἀκούω κρίνω καὶ ἡ κρίσις ἡ ἐμὴ δικαία ἐστίν ὅτι οὐ ζητῶ τὸ θέλημα τὸ ἐμὸν ἀλλὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με
verses.transliteration: Ou dynamai egō poiein ap’ emautou ouden kathōs akouō krinō kai hē krisis hē emē dikaia estin hoti ou zētō to thelēma to emon alla to thelēma tou pempsantos me
verses.literal: I can do nothing by Myself I judge only as I hear And My judgment is just because I do not seek My own will but the will of Him who sent Me

verses.original: Ἐὰν ἐγὼ μαρτυρῶ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ ἡ μαρτυρία μου οὐκ ἔστιν ἀληθής
verses.transliteration: Ean egō martyrō peri emautou hē martyria mou ouk estin alēthēs
verses.literal: If I testify about Myself My testimony is not valid

verses.original: ἄλλος ἐστὶν ὁ μαρτυρῶν περὶ ἐμοῦ καὶ οἶδα ὅτι ἀληθής ἐστιν ἡ μαρτυρία ἣν μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: allos estin ho martyrōn peri emou kai oida hoti alēthēs estin hē martyria hēn martyrei peri emou
verses.literal: There is another who testifies about Me and I know that His testimony . . . . . . about Me is valid

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς ἀπεστάλκατε πρὸς Ἰωάννην καὶ μεμαρτύρηκεν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ
verses.transliteration: Hymeis apestalkate pros Iōannēn kai memartyrēken tē alētheia
verses.literal: You have sent to John and he has testified to the truth

verses.original: ἐγὼ δὲ οὐ παρὰ ἀνθρώπου τὴν μαρτυρίαν λαμβάνω ἀλλὰ ταῦτα λέγω ἵνα ὑμεῖς σωθῆτε
verses.transliteration: egō de ou para anthrōpou tēn martyrian lambanō alla tauta legō hina hymeis sōthēte
verses.literal: Even though I do not accept human testimony I say these things so that you may be saved

verses.original: Ἐκεῖνος ἦν ὁ λύχνος ὁ καιόμενος καὶ φαίνων ὑμεῖς δὲ ἠθελήσατε ἀγαλλιαθῆναι πρὸς ὥραν ἐν τῷ φωτὶ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ekeinos ēn ho lychnos ho kaiomenos kai phainōn hymeis de ēthelēsate agalliathēnai pros hōran en tō phōti autou
verses.literal: John was a lamp that burned and gave light and you were willing for a season to bask in his light

verses.original: ἐγὼ δὲ ἔχω τὴν μαρτυρίαν μείζω τοῦ Ἰωάννου τὰ γὰρ ἔργα ἃ δέδωκέν μοι ὁ Πατὴρ ἵνα τελειώσω αὐτά αὐτὰ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ποιῶ μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ ὅτι ὁ Πατήρ με ἀπέσταλκεν
verses.transliteration: egō de echō tēn martyrian meizō tou Iōannou ta gar erga ha dedōken moi ho Patēr hina teleiōsō auta auta ta erga ha poiō martyrei peri emou hoti ho Patēr me apestalken
verses.literal: But I have testimony more substantial than that of John For the works that the Father has given Me to accomplish . . . the very works I am doing testify about Me that the Father has sent Me

verses.original: καὶ ὁ πέμψας με Πατὴρ ἐκεῖνος μεμαρτύρηκεν περὶ ἐμοῦ οὔτε φωνὴν αὐτοῦ πώποτε ἀκηκόατε οὔτε εἶδος αὐτοῦ ἑωράκατε
verses.transliteration: kai ho pempsas me Patēr ekeinos memartyrēken peri emou oute phōnēn autou pōpote akēkoate oute eidos autou heōrakate
verses.literal: And the Father who sent Me has Himself testified . . . about Me You have never heard His voice nor seen His form

verses.original: καὶ τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔχετε ἐν ὑμῖν μένοντα ὅτι ὃν ἀπέστειλεν ἐκεῖνος τούτῳ ὑμεῖς οὐ πιστεύετε
verses.transliteration: kai ton logon autou ouk echete en hymin menonta hoti hon apesteilen ekeinos toutō hymeis ou pisteuete
verses.literal: nor . . . does His word abide in you because you do not believe the One . . . He sent

verses.original: Ἐραυνᾶτε τὰς γραφάς ὅτι ὑμεῖς δοκεῖτε ἐν αὐταῖς ζωὴν αἰώνιον ἔχειν καὶ ἐκεῖναί εἰσιν αἱ μαρτυροῦσαι περὶ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eraunate tas graphas hoti hymeis dokeite en autais zōēn aiōnion echein kai ekeinai eisin hai martyrousai peri emou
verses.literal: You pore over the Scriptures because you presume that by them you possess eternal life These are the very words that testify about Me

verses.original: καὶ οὐ θέλετε ἐλθεῖν πρός με ἵνα ζωὴν ἔχητε
verses.transliteration: kai ou thelete elthein pros me hina zōēn echēte
verses.literal: yet you refuse to come to Me to have life

verses.original: Δόξαν παρὰ ἀνθρώπων οὐ λαμβάνω
verses.transliteration: Doxan para anthrōpōn ou lambanō
verses.literal: I do not accept glory from men

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἔγνωκα ὑμᾶς ὅτι τὴν ἀγάπην τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐκ ἔχετε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς
verses.transliteration: alla egnōka hymas hoti tēn agapēn tou Theou ouk echete en heautois
verses.literal: but I know you that you do not have the love of God within you

verses.original: ἐγὼ ἐλήλυθα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Πατρός μου καὶ οὐ λαμβάνετέ με ἐὰν ἄλλος ἔλθῃ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τῷ ἰδίῳ ἐκεῖνον λήμψεσθε
verses.transliteration: egō elēlytha en tō onomati tou Patros mou kai ou lambanete me ean allos elthē en tō onomati tō idiō ekeinon lēmpsesthe
verses.literal: I have come in My Father’s name and you have not received Me but if someone else comes in his own name you will receive him

verses.original: πῶς δύνασθε ὑμεῖς πιστεῦσαι δόξαν παρὰ ἀλλήλων λαμβάνοντες καὶ τὴν δόξαν τὴν παρὰ τοῦ μόνου Θεοῦ οὐ ζητεῖτε
verses.transliteration: pōs dynasthe hymeis pisteusai doxan para allēlōn lambanontes kai tēn doxan tēn para tou monou Theou ou zēteite
verses.literal: How can you believe if you accept glory from one another yet do not seek the glory that comes from the only God

verses.original: Μὴ δοκεῖτε ὅτι ἐγὼ κατηγορήσω ὑμῶν πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα ἔστιν ὁ κατηγορῶν ὑμῶν Μωϋσῆς εἰς ὃν ὑμεῖς ἠλπίκατε
verses.transliteration: Mē dokeite hoti egō katēgorēsō hymōn pros ton Patera estin ho katēgorōn hymōn Mōusēs eis hon hymeis ēlpikate
verses.literal: Do not think that I will accuse you before the Father Your accuser is Moses in whom you have put your hope

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ ἐπιστεύετε Μωϋσεῖ ἐπιστεύετε ἂν ἐμοί περὶ γὰρ ἐμοῦ ἐκεῖνος ἔγραψεν
verses.transliteration: ei gar episteuete Mōusei episteuete an emoi peri gar emou ekeinos egrapsen
verses.literal: If you had believed Moses you would believe Me because he wrote about Me

verses.original: εἰ δὲ τοῖς ἐκείνου γράμμασιν οὐ πιστεύετε πῶς τοῖς ἐμοῖς ῥήμασιν πιστεύσετε
verses.transliteration: ei de tois ekeinou grammasin ou pisteuete pōs tois emois rhēmasin pisteusete
verses.literal: But since you do not believe what he wrote how will you believe what I say
